key_idea: Where two cubes touch, those faces are hidden and need no colour.
steps: Each cube has 6 faces. 4 cubes have 4 x 6 = 24 faces.
Each place where two cubes touch hides 2 faces.
In the square, the cubes touch in 4 places. 24 - 8 = 16 faces need colour.
In every other figure, the cubes touch in only 3 places. 24 - 6 = 18 faces need colour.
